prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a low-speed head-on collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1148; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not clear whether all of the damage came from this impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Front bumper cover cracked at the center with the grille tabs broken, the upper radiator support bent, and the hood latch and headlamp brackets deformed. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover, grille, and hood latch, straightening the radiator support, and refinishing the affected panels. Some of the lower-level damage may or may not stem from this impact, so the seam pattern on the lower valance will be checked before final sign-off. The repair labor hours fit the damage described. The billing records show no repeated charges, and no earlier damage to the vehicle is known to us.
